The response gives a basic definition and a simple coin-flip example, but it is very brief and does not fulfill the request for an easy-to-understand, step-by-step explanation. It also introduces “descriptive probability” and “inferential probability,” which are not standard types of probability and may confuse the learner. It lacks key concepts like the probability formula, sample space, events, complements, and everyday examples beyond coin flipping. Overall, it is somewhat relevant but inaccurate and not very helpful.

Rating: [[3]]
